decisive_items: a known plexiform neurofibroma of the arm confirmed by biopsy 1 year earlier
parasellar mass consistent with a meningioma
response.rationale: The constellation of bilateral vestibular schwannomas, meningioma, and cervical extramedullary lesion strongly indicates neurofibromatosis type 2, despite the label of NF1; the plexiform neurofibroma is also a neurofibromatosis feature. R3 only captures one tumor component, while R4 encompasses the syndromic diagnosis.

rejected.why: PAMM is an ocular manifestation, not the underlying systemic diagnosis.
Meningioma is a single tumor component, not the unifying syndrome.
Optic disc swelling is a sign, not a diagnosis.
